cs.t: HP Wireless Elite V2.  I have one for home, one for work, and I've been using it for about a decade.  Best keyboard I've ever owned.  It's a scissor-switch keyboard like the Thinkpad keyboard or old Mac wireless keyboards.  It's satisfyingly clicky with ultra-low travel and keyboard keys.
